description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for managing favorite recipes in a local database using Room in an Android application. It includes methods for retrieving all favorites, checking if a specific recipe is favored, adding favorites, and removing favorites by ID.

classes.name: FavoritesDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object interface for performing database operations related to favorite items in the 'favorites' table.

methods.name: getAllFavorites
methods.description: Retrieves all favorite entities from the database ordered by title.

methods.name: isFavorite
methods.description: Checks if a recipe with the specified ID exists in the favorites table.

methods.name: addFavorite
methods.description: Inserts or updates a favorite entity in the database, replacing any existing entry with the same primary key.

methods.name: removeFavoriteById
methods.description: Removes a favorite entry from the database based on the recipe ID.

calls: androidx.room.Query("SELECT * FROM favorites ORDER BY title ASC")
androidx.room.Query("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM favorites WHERE recipeId = :id)")
